spec_match.rationale: Enumerates the real HID/HIDDevice member surface read from this browser, annotating each member with its permission/gesture requirement, and calls getDevices() live — the API surface the Android expansion ships.

interactive.rationale: The poll button re-runs a real getDevices() call; verified it returned an empty list with the correct not-an-error explanation.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The card promises the member inventory with the needs-a-gesture/permission distinction, which the tables deliver from live reads.

edge_cases.rationale: The empty-getDevices case is explicitly de-dramatised ('not an error and not a capability check'), and the banner separates presence from Android availability.

conformance.rationale: The suite's surface and no-gesture-getDevices assertions mirror this page; 6 pass / 0 fail on Chromium 141 where WebHID is genuinely present on desktop.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Chromium 141 headless (cloud, no chrome-devtools-mcp): banner confirmed presence, member tables rendered from the real prototypes, getDevices() polled live returning 0 devices with honest copy; console clean, screenshots read.

telemetry_health.rationale: Loads demo-telemetry.js and logs presence and device counts.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables, captioned tables, banner state as text, no static card.

accessibility.rationale: Captioned tables with scoped headers, aria-live detail, labelled 44px poll button.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: No horizontal overflow at 360x740 DPR3 (scrollWidth 360, screenshot read).

summary: Reviewed at http://localhost:3000/v154/support-for-specialized-webhid-devices-on-android/hid-surface/ with Chromium 141 headless (cloud, no chrome-devtools-mcp), a desktop Linux build where WebHID is present. The member inventory is read from the real objects, getDevices() runs live (empty list, correctly explained as the usual non-error state), and the banner cleanly separates 'the API is here' from 'this feature is about Android'. Console/network clean bar the sandbox font-CDN artifact; no mobile overflow; feature /conformance/ ran 6 pass / 0 fail. Clears the bar.
